cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I'll carry your book bag to the platform. My shoulder should manage one more staircase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let me take it. There are dictionaries in there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. No, keep your hands free for the tickets. I'll change shoulders at the bottom.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've moved our train to platform twelve, across the bridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, lead the way. I'll give each shoulder a staircase and rest my fingers while you find our seats.

mechanism: A copies a misunderstood courteous practice, accommodates B graciously, and makes the personal cost increasingly visible.
confusable: Unlike angry helpfulness, D45 stays gracious; S04 must supply a mistaken model rather than generic politeness.
comparison: Host giving up dinner versus carrying a heavy bag on a changed route.
seedUse: Preserve B helpful pizza offer and bag-sharing offer as causes, not hostile obstructions.
